question: Which waves fall in the range of the EM spectrum between radio and IR used in modern technology such as wireless networks, spacecraft communication, medical diathermy, and cancer treatment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Microwaves**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Microwaves **fall in the range of the EM spectrum between radio and IR used in modern technology such as wireless networks, spacecraft communication, medical diathermy, and cancer treatment.
 
• It is used in modern technologies such as** wireless networks, microwave radio relay networks, radar, satellite and spacecraft communications, medical diathermy and cancer treatment, remote sensing, radio astronomy, particle accelerators, spectrography, industrial heating, collision avoidance systems, garage door openers and keyless entry systems, and for cooking food in microwave ovens.**
 
• They come in the range of 1mm to 1 meter and of a frequency range between 300 MHz to 300 GHz.
